criteria.text:
Given a repo whose config sets no commissaire.governor
When `faff run open --mode full --root R --session-id S --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with governance "admitted" and steps.poller "ok"
And the new run ledger has owner.status "running", an owner.harness value and budget.measure_root equal to R
criteria.exercised: Fresh git repo /tmp/eval/r1 with .faff/config.yaml lacking commissaire.governor; `faff run open --mode full --root /tmp/eval/r1 --session-id S1 --json`; read run-ledger.json
criteria.expected: exit 0, governance admitted, steps.poller ok; ledger owner.status running, owner.harness set, budget.measure_root = R
criteria.observed: rc=0; governance "admitted"; steps.poller "ok"; ledger owner.status "running", owner.harness "claude-code", budget.measure_root "/tmp/eval/r1"

criteria.text:
Given a repo whose config sets commissaire.governor to an endpoint nothing listens on
When `faff run open --mode full --root R --session-id S --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with governance "fail-closed"
And the ledger shows owner.status "done" and stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"
And <run_dir>/commissaire/governance-required.json exists
And `faff sentry-poller status --run-dir <run_dir> --json` prints running false with no pid
And events.jsonl contains a run-end event with data.stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"
criteria.exercised: Fresh repo /tmp/eval/r2, config commissaire.governor: http://127.0.0.1:9; `faff run open --mode full --root /tmp/eval/r2 --session-id S2 --json`; read ledger, commissaire/, `faff sentry-poller status --run-dir D --json`, grep events.jsonl
criteria.expected: exit 3, governance fail-closed; owner.status done, stop_reason governance-admit-failed; governance-required.json exists; poller status running false, no pid; run-end event with data.stop_reason governance-admit-failed
criteria.observed: rc=3; governance "fail-closed" (cause governor-unreachable); owner.status "done", stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"; commissaire/governance-required.json = {"governance_required":true,"governor":"http://127.0.0.1:9"}; poller status {"running":false}; events.jsonl run-end data.stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"

criteria.text:
Given a run D opened by `faff run open --mode full --max 5` that exited 0, and FAFF_RUN_DIR set to D
When `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S --json` runs, and then again with --max 9
Then the first exits 0 with governance "already-governed" and the second exits 2
And the ledger's budget envelope still has max_attempts 5
criteria.exercised: Fresh repo /tmp/eval/r3 (no governor); `out=$(faff run open --mode full --max 5 ... --export)` rc 0, eval to set FAFF_RUN_DIR=D; `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S3 --json`; again with `--max 9`; read ledger envelope
criteria.expected: first adopt exit 0 governance already-governed; second exit 2; envelope max_attempts 5
criteria.observed: first adopt rc=0, governance "already-governed"; second rc=2 fault "budget envelope already set: max_attempts 9 differs from the recorded 5"; ledger budget.envelope.ceilings.max_attempts 5 (ledger byte-identical across the second call)

criteria.text:
Given `faff run open --mode full --until 25:99 --root R --session-id S`
When it runs
Then it exits 2
And no new directory exists under R/.faff/runs
criteria.exercised: Fresh repo /tmp/eval/r4 with no .faff/runs; `faff run open --mode full --until 25:99 --root /tmp/eval/r4 --session-id S4`; also repeated with --json after creating an empty .faff/runs; compare directory listing before/after
criteria.expected: exit 2; no new directory under R/.faff/runs
criteria.observed: rc=2 both times, stderr 'until "25:99" is not a valid HH:MM'; .faff/runs not created on the first call, empty after the second (0 entries); --json run_dir null, every step skipped

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with admitted ["A","B"] and outcomes {"A":"shipped"}
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drained --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with undispatched ["B"]
And run-ledger.json and events.jsonl are byte-identical to before
criteria.exercised: Run minted by `faff run open` in /tmp/eval/r5, poller stopped and exited, ledger admitted [A,B] outcomes {A:shipped}; `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drained --json`; cmp ledger and events.jsonl against copies
criteria.expected: exit 3 with undispatched [B]; run-ledger.json and events.jsonl byte-identical
criteria.observed: rc=3; closed false, undispatched ["B"], all steps skipped; cmp: run-ledger.json and events.jsonl identical

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with admitted ["A","B"], outcomes {"A":"shipped"}, an abort entry with status "aborted-resumable" and owner.status "aborted-resumable"
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason sentry-abort --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with undispatched ["B"]
And the ledger's stop_reason is "sentry-abort", owner.status is still "aborted-resumable" and outcomes has no entry for "B"
And events.jsonl contains a run-end event with data.stop_reason "sentry-abort"
criteria.exercised: Run minted in /tmp/eval/r6, poller stopped and exited, ledger admitted [A,B] outcomes {A:shipped}; real `faff sentry abort --run-dir D` (owner and abort.status aborted-resumable); `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason sentry-abort --json`; read ledger, grep events.jsonl
criteria.expected: exit 0 with undispatched [B]; stop_reason sentry-abort, owner.status aborted-resumable, no outcomes entry for B; run-end event with data.stop_reason sentry-abort
criteria.observed: rc=0; closed true, abort_exempt true, undispatched ["B"], conclude ran for A only; ledger stop_reason "sentry-abort", owner.status "aborted-resumable", outcomes {"A":"shipped"}; events.jsonl run-end data.stop_reason "sentry-abort"

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with every admitted issue terminal
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drianed` runs
Then it exits 2 and run-ledger.json is unchanged
criteria.exercised: Run minted in /tmp/eval/r7, poller stopped and exited, ledger admitted [A,B] outcomes {A:shipped,B:parked} (`faff runcheck` clean); `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drianed`; cmp ledger
criteria.observed: rc=2, stderr 'unknown stop reason "queue-drianed"'; cmp: run-ledger.json (and events.jsonl) identical

criteria.text:
Given a run D whose owner.status is "running" and FAFF_RUN_DIR is unset
When `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S` runs
Then it exits 2
And run-ledger.json is byte-identical to before
criteria.exercised: Run minted in /tmp/eval/r8 (owner.status running), poller stopped and exited, FAFF_RUN_DIR unset; `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root /tmp/eval/r8 --session-id S8`; cmp ledger
criteria.observed: rc=2, stderr 'adopt refused: $FAFF_RUN_DIR does not name this run'; cmp: run-ledger.json (and events.jsonl) identical; no poller started
